months.note: 국내에서는 겨울을 나며, 번식깃으로 꽤 늦게 갈아입고 한국재갈매기보다 한 달 이상 늦게 번식한다.

summary: 제주도 차귀도에서 서해안까지, 그리고 동해안 묵호 등지에서 겨울을 나는 갈매기이다. 한국재갈매기와 달리 민물을 그다지 찾지 않고 대개 바닷물, 그중에서도 갯벌에서 많이 눈에 띈다. 시베리아 맨 북쪽에서 번식하며, 번식기가 다가올수록 다리가 아주 노란 개체가 늘어난다. 덩치는 재갈매기보다 훨씬 작은 개체도 있는데, 이런 개체는 대개 눈이 작고 머리 모양이 날렵하다.

points.en: small eye and sleek head shape (smaller birds)
large red spot on the lower mandible

similar.how: 등이 더 짙고, 아랫부리의 붉은 점이 더 크며, 훨씬 작은 개체도 있다.
등이 더 짙고, 민물보다 바닷물과 갯벌을 찾으며, 한 달 이상 늦게 번식한다.

art.subject: Lesser Black-backed Gull of the heuglini form (Larus heuglini), adult in winter as seen on Korean west-coast tidal flats: head white with only fine, sparse grey-brown streaks on the crown and hindneck; mantle and folded wings dark slate-grey, much darker than a Vega Gull's; a broad white crescent on the tertials; long black primaries with small white tips and a small white mirror near the tip of the outermost feather; underparts and tail white. Bill yellow with a large red spot on the lower mandible; pale yellow iris with a red orbital ring; legs yellow.
art.pose: standing on wet mud at low tide, side view
art.scene: Korean west coast in winter: a broad tidal mudflat at low tide under a pale sky; no people, buildings or text
views: adult winter, side view standing: dark slate-grey back and wings, white head with fine streaks on the hindneck, long black wingtips projecting well beyond the tail, yellow bill with a large red gonys spot, yellow legs
adult, head close-up in side view: sleek, rather small head, small pale yellow eye with a red orbital ring, slim yellow bill with a large red spot on the lower mandible
art.build: Large but slim, long-winged gull, slightly smaller and more slender than the Vega Gull and clearly larger than the Black-tailed Gull, with a sleek head; many smaller birds show a small-looking eye. Bill yellow, fairly slim and parallel-sided. At rest the long black primaries project far beyond the tail, giving an attenuated rear end. Legs medium length, yellow, palest in winter and brightest towards spring. In flight dark grey upperwing with a white trailing edge and black outer primaries with very little white.
avoid: Do not paint pink legs — Vega and Slaty-backed Gulls have pink legs; this gull's legs are yellow.
Do not paint a pale silvery-grey back like a Vega Gull's.
Do not paint a black tail band or a black-and-red ring near the bill tip (Black-tailed Gull).
Do not paint heavy brown streaking hooding the whole head; winter streaking is fine and limited.
